test_objective: Check that you cannot append entity attributes with invalid/missing id or invalid request body

test_cases.name: 010_05_01 Append entity attributes with invalid entity fragments
test_cases.doc: Check that you cannot append entity attributes with invalid entity fragments
test_cases.teardown: Delete Entity by Id Returning Response
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}/attrs'
        method set to 'POST'
        Append Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to 'invalid-fragment.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}
